sections.heading: Ship Classes
items: Ketch – starter ship. Small cargo and light armament, but fast and cheap to repair.
Brig – mid-game workhorse. Good balance of speed, hull, and cannon count. Aim for this after the first boss.
Frigate / Galleon – endgame. Heavy hull, many guns, slow turning. Requires rare materials and a large crew.

sections.heading: Upgrades
items: Cannons – the biggest DPS upgrade. Replace starter cannons as soon as you have metal ingots.
Hull Bracing – reduces damage taken. Hull Bracing: Keelhold is considered the strongest endgame option.
Sails – speed and maneuverability. Faster sails make kiting and positioning easier.
Crew quarters – more crew lets you reload and repair faster during long fights.

sections.heading: Build Priority
items: Early: repair kits + basic Round Shot stockpile.
Mid: better cannons, hull bracing, and a Brig.
Late: specialized ammo (Bar Shot, Grape), reinforced hull, and Frigate/Galleon.
